cases.title: The Missing Painting
cases.victim_context: A rare painting vanished from the Sharma Art Gallery during last night's private viewing.

suspects.name: Sana Kapoor
suspects.personality: Calm and polished on the surface, but gives short, guarded answers.
suspects.alibi_text: I was taking inventory in the back room.

breaking_clue.text: The back room motion sensor log shows no movement during the time Gallery Assistant Sana claimed to be there.

suspects.name: Dev Malhotra
suspects.personality: Smug and confident, enjoys being a suspect, subtly arrogant.
suspects.alibi_text: I was chatting with the mayor in the main hall.

breaking_clue.text: The mayor's official schedule confirms he left the event an hour before Collector Dev claims they spoke.

suspects.name: Arjun Joshi
suspects.personality: Friendly and chatty, tries to charm the detective, deflects with humor.
suspects.alibi_text: I was admiring the sculptures in the east wing.

breaking_clue.text: The east wing was locked and sealed for renovation all night, meaning Art Critic Arjun could not enter.

suspects.name: Neha Rao
suspects.personality: Formal and procedural, quotes 'protocol' often, avoids blame.
suspects.alibi_text: I was patrolling the second floor corridors.

breaking_clue.text: A sleeping mask and coffee cup were found at Security Guard Neha's desk, with no patrol logged.

suspects.name: Ravi Mehta
suspects.personality: Nervous, over-explains everything, talks fast when pressed.
suspects.alibi_text: I was in my office on a business call.

breaking_clue.text: Telecom logs confirm no outgoing or incoming calls were made from Gallery Owner Ravi's office phone.

cases.title: The Locked Office
cases.victim_context: CEO Vikram Anand was found unconscious in his locked office after the company party.

suspects.name: Priya Nair
suspects.personality: Soft-spoken, worried, tends to over-apologize.
suspects.alibi_text: I was cleaning the lobby on the ground floor.

breaking_clue.text: Cleaning staff Priya Nair's mop bucket was found abandoned right outside the CEO's 5th floor office.

suspects.name: Karan Verma
suspects.personality: Blunt, short answers, slightly defensive about being questioned at all.
suspects.alibi_text: I was parked outside waiting in the car the whole night.

breaking_clue.text: The parking lot camera shows Driver Karan's designated vehicle left the lot for an hour at 10 PM.

suspects.name: Anita Desai
suspects.personality: Cold, logical, treats the interrogation like a business meeting.
suspects.alibi_text: I left the party early to go home.

breaking_clue.text: A neighbor's doorbell camera shows CFO Anita Desai returning home past 1 AM, not early.

suspects.name: Rahul Singh
suspects.personality: Anxious, eager to please, stutters when nervous.
suspects.alibi_text: I was getting drinks for everyone from the kitchen.

breaking_clue.text: Catering staff confirmed the kitchen was closed and Intern Rahul never requested any drinks.

suspects.name: Meera Iyer
suspects.personality: Overly organized, quotes exact times and schedules, sounds rehearsed.
suspects.alibi_text: I was checking the sound system in the ballroom.

breaking_clue.text: The DJ testified that the sound system was packed away hours earlier without Event Planner Meera.

cases.title: The Vanishing Bride
cases.victim_context: The bride disappeared minutes before her wedding at the Rosewood Resort.

suspects.name: Aman Gupta
suspects.personality: Frantic, emotional, desperate to find his bride.
suspects.alibi_text: I was getting dressed in my suite.

breaking_clue.text: The groomsmen testified Groom Aman locked them out of the suite and was missing for 30 minutes.

suspects.name: Simran Kaur
suspects.personality: Sarcastic, gossipy, doesn't seem very sad about the disappearance.
suspects.alibi_text: I was touching up my makeup in the ladies' room.

breaking_clue.text: A guest reported seeing Maid of Honor Simran having a furious argument outside the bridal suite.

suspects.name: Rohan Das
suspects.personality: Defensive, bitter, insists he only came to wish her well.
suspects.alibi_text: I was at the bar getting a drink.

breaking_clue.text: The resort bartender confirms Ex-Boyfriend Rohan was cut off and stormed toward the bridal wing.

suspects.name: Nina Patel
suspects.personality: Stressed, constantly checking her watch, obsessed with the schedule.
suspects.alibi_text: I was dealing with the florist at the front gate.

breaking_clue.text: The gate guard log confirms the florist arrived hours before Planner Nina claims she met them.

suspects.name: Mrs. Sharma
suspects.personality: Haughty, traditional, very concerned about family reputation.
suspects.alibi_text: I was greeting guests in the reception area.

breaking_clue.text: Several guests mentioned Groom's mother Mrs. Sharma was completely missing from the reception line.

cases.title: The Poisoned Toast
cases.victim_context: A prominent politician collapsed after drinking a toast at a charity gala.

suspects.name: Vikram Singh
suspects.personality: Smooth-talking, deflects questions with political jargon.
suspects.alibi_text: I was giving an interview to the press in the lobby.

breaking_clue.text: The press corps sign-out log proves all journalists had left before Rival Vikram Singh claims they interviewed him.

suspects.name: Chef Marco
suspects.personality: Proud, easily offended if you question his food, speaks passionately.
suspects.alibi_text: I was in the kitchen plating the dessert.

breaking_clue.text: A banquet waiter saw Head Caterer Chef Marco tampering with the drink table just before the toast.

suspects.name: Tara Menon
suspects.personality: Intense, speaks quickly, always holding a phone.
suspects.alibi_text: I was outside making an urgent campaign call.

breaking_clue.text: Phone carrier records confirm Campaign Manager Tara Menon made no phone calls all evening.

suspects.name: Rajiv Khanna
suspects.personality: Laid-back, observant, answers casually.
suspects.alibi_text: I was restocking glasses from the back room.

breaking_clue.text: The glassware back room remained locked and untracked, meaning Bartender Rajiv was elsewhere.

suspects.name: Sonia Verma
suspects.personality: Cynical, asks questions back to the detective, highly observant.
suspects.alibi_text: I was taking photos from the balcony.

breaking_clue.text: Security had locked the balcony doors from inside, preventing Journalist Sonia from being there.

cases.title: The Midnight Heist
cases.victim_context: Three million dollars in untraceable diamonds were stolen from a high-security vault.

suspects.name: Mr. Oberoi
suspects.personality: Sweating profusely, overly cooperative, insists the vault is impenetrable.
suspects.alibi_text: I was asleep at home, miles away.

breaking_clue.text: Bank Manager Mr. Oberoi's personal car was ticketed for parking outside the bank at 1 AM.

suspects.name: Jai Kumar
suspects.personality: Sleepy, confused, defensively claims he never fell asleep.
suspects.alibi_text: I was doing my hourly rounds on the second floor.

breaking_clue.text: The electronic badge log shows Night Guard Jai Kumar never left the ground floor desk.

suspects.name: Samir Khan
suspects.personality: Technical, uses jargon, dismissive of non-experts.
suspects.alibi_text: I was out of town at a security conference.

breaking_clue.text: A motel receipt shows Vault Tech Samir Khan checked in across the street from the bank that night.

suspects.name: Maya Singh
suspects.personality: Quiet, avoids eye contact, claims she saw nothing.
suspects.alibi_text: I was vacuuming the manager's office.

breaking_clue.text: Cleaner Maya Singh's vacuum was discovered locked in the closet, cold and completely unused.

suspects.name: Tony 'Fingers'
suspects.personality: Cocky, uses slang, openly admits to past crimes but denies this one.
suspects.alibi_text: I was playing cards at the club.

breaking_clue.text: The card club bouncer confirmed Tony 'Fingers' was kicked out hours before he claims he was playing.

cases.title: The Ghost Ship
cases.victim_context: A luxury yacht arrived at the dock with the engine running, but the owner was completely missing.

suspects.name: Captain Morgan
suspects.personality: Gruff, uses nautical terms, defensive about his ship.
suspects.alibi_text: I was steering the ship from the bridge the entire time.

breaking_clue.text: The helm log proves Captain Morgan engaged the autopilot for 3 hours while the yacht drifted.

suspects.name: Leo
suspects.personality: Young, nervous, keeps looking around the room.
suspects.alibi_text: I was in the lower deck fixing a leak.

breaking_clue.text: The maintenance log proves Deckhand Leo performed zero leak repairs anywhere on the vessel.

suspects.name: Isabella
suspects.personality: Glamorous, surprisingly calm, sheds fake tears.
suspects.alibi_text: I was sunbathing on the top deck.

breaking_clue.text: The marine weather log proves torrential rain fell all night, making sunbathing for Isabella impossible.

suspects.name: Dr. Vance
suspects.personality: Clinical, precise, cites medical confidentiality.
suspects.alibi_text: I was reading in my cabin.

breaking_clue.text: Dr. Vance's electronic keycard was found dropped near the wet stern railing where the owner vanished.

suspects.name: Chef Gordon
suspects.personality: Loud, angry, curses frequently.
suspects.alibi_text: I was preparing dinner in the galley.

breaking_clue.text: The galley stove was cold to the touch, proving Chef Gordon never cooked or prepared any dinner.

clues.text: A torn ticket stub was found near the side entrance.
Someone reported a broken window on the east wing, unrelated to the case.
A guest mentioned smelling cigarette smoke near the garden, though smoking wasn't allowed.
Two staff members were overheard arguing about shift schedules earlier that day.
A muddy footprint was found near the back door, but it matches a common work boot.
The lights flickered momentarily around 9:30 PM due to a known city power surge.
A suspicious black van was seen idling on the street, but it belonged to a plumbing service.
An anonymous tip called the police, but it turned out to be a prank from a local teenager.
A shattered wine glass was found on the floor, likely dropped by a clumsy waiter.
A cryptic note reading 'It ends tonight' was found, but it was just a discarded movie script.
